title: Human X/Y Pad
subtitle: Interactive Expressive Controller & Audio DSP
description: An expressive human-computer interaction system that maps spatial motion and gestural input across two-dimensional X/Y boundaries to dynamic DSP audio synthesis and real-time parameters.
longDescription: Human X/Y Pad is a physical and gestural control interface that transforms human motion across a two-dimensional X/Y spatial axis into fluid, continuous sound design control and digital signal processing. By capturing real-time positional data, velocity, and pressure dynamics, the system generates continuous parameter curves for spatial panning, filter modulation, wavetable morphing, and generative audio synthesis.
